html:
I just set up Grok @Bot to remotely control my autonomous robot lawn mower that is 50 miles away. It literally took 2 minutes to set up.

I told it to start mowing and it started 3 seconds later. Then I had it dock itself. This is so wild lol.

I'm gonna set up my vacuum next,… pic.twitter.com/7DJ9E0wh2F

— Sawyer Merritt (@SawyerMerritt) August 19, 2026
